expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.T===5800 && S.alue==='lyhyt' && Math.abs(S.lmax-499.62)<0.05 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: T = 5800 K, short wavelengths, λ_max = 499,6 nm (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const O=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select option')].map(o=>o.value).join(','); return R.length===1 && R[0].min==='200' && R[0].max==='10000' && R[0].step==='100' && O==='lyhyt,pitka' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: one slider T 200–10 000 K by 100; one select lyhyt | pitka

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='T,alue' && P.T.unit==='K' ? 1 : 0 })()

setup: const R=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'), Se=document.querySelector('#sim-root select'); const I=(e,v)=>{e.value=v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}; I(R,3000); I(Se,'lyhyt');
note: 3000 K: λ_max = 966 nm, the curve's peak
